title: Learning Environment
journeyNote: Before entering the classroom, one must understand the environment where learning takes place.
vision: To produce high school graduates who are God-fearing, morally upright, socially responsible, creative thinker, civic spirited and life skilled- a product of holistic and innovative learning.
mission: To provide world-class, superior, high quality, responsive secondary education to students transforming them to be very prepared to enter higher education and at the same time, responsible, humane and productive citizens.
history: Conceived in 1999 by Virgilio Luat and residents, the school was built on BCDA land with a four-storey building donated by Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano. Opened on August 15, 2007, it became autonomous from SVNHS-Main and now serves approximately 2,200 students with heavy support from Mayor Laarni L. Cayetano.
facilitiesDescription: Classroom buildings, science laboratories, computer workshops, administrative offices, and athletic grounds supporting approximately 2,200 learners.
